sourceDocuments.title: Vocational Technical Training Curricula in South-South Polytechnics
sourceDocuments.text: Technical college pedagogy requires hands-on lathe turning, foundry molding, and circuit diagnosis rather than theoretical memorization.

studentDocument.title: Subnational Governance Impediments to Basic Education Financing
studentDocument.text: The Universal Basic Education Act of 2004 established free, compulsory nine-year continuous education for every Nigerian child of primary and junior secondary school age. However, persistent counter-part funding bottlenecks among subnational state governments impede infrastructure disbursement from the consolidated intervention fund.
